outcome_access_at_registration: Only inventory and prior evidence counts inspected; no new team quality outcomes inspected by root
scope: Independent additional descriptors; not a Q component or general worker total score

behavior_types.repeated_retention_observed: supported, at least two observed known-initial-error unchanged events
behavior_types.no_retention_reported_on_observed_opport: supported, zero reported events; edited-outcome success remains unknown
behavior_types.insufficient_opportunity: support gate fails or no opportunities; do not encode as zero risk

team_comparison.baseline: QTD selection on workers with supported evidence, within ONE evidence source level
team_comparison.candidate: Use the same theta >= kth theta - 3 quality candidate set; prioritize lower observed retention fraction, then relative source time and theta as frozen tie breakers
team_comparison.interpretation: Exploratory behavioral tie-breaker on audited subsets. Targeted audits and task assignment are not eliminated; no population severe-error or correction success claim.

excluded_as_selectors.scope_correctness: All 93 compatible opportunities are in-scope and correct; no discriminating evidence or out-of-scope false acceptance evidence
excluded_as_selectors.severe_error_rate: No independently adjudicated severity gold or random audit denominator
